subject: spanish
title: Describing Family
welcome_lead: Mi, mis — possessives and family talk.
meta_desc: KS3 Spanish: possessive adjectives, family description.
final_note: Combine words to describe your family.

walkthroughs.body_html: Mi = my (singular, any gender). Mis = my (plural). 'Mi hermano' (my brother), 'mis padres' (my parents).
'En mi familia hay cuatro personas' = 'In my family there are four people'. Hay = there is/are.
'Tengo un hermano. Se llama Tom' = 'I have a brother. His name is Tom'. Combine 'tengo' with names and ages to describe everyone.
